name: Four Knights Game
description: A calm open-game course that teaches natural development and common replies after 1.e4 e5.

branches.title: Main Line: Four Knights
branches.description: Develop all knights toward the center.

moves.title: Start with e4
moves.explanation: Open the center and piece lines. e4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Four Knights usually becomes a calm development race: castle, complete pieces, and avoid unnecessary pawn grabs.
